about: Frames are pixel rectangles in the sheet. Draw a frame at (cell_x - origin[0], cell_y - origin[1]) where (cell_x, cell_y) is the top-left of the character's cell-sized footprint. 'any' = not directional. timing 'guide' = Shade's Miniworld guide; 'assumed' = guide value reused.
